answer: At the end of the week the tallyman notches the tally stick for every wheel sold, splitting the stick down the middle so buyer and seller each keep half the count. Herb cream curd presser rind bond governs the notching: a bond cream curd pressers lodge after press room trials. The vault begins the notching, the walnut completes the stick, the willow keeps the count. A cheat would need 397 false notches and 397 false splittings.
